hero.title: Embedded Software Solutions — Secure for Every Industry
hero.description: Over 20 years of embedded expertise in mission-critical systems, from in-vehicle platforms to robust, cloud-connected applications. We focus on quality, compliance, and a user-first experience to ensure your products excel in competitive markets.

items.title: Automotive
items.description: ISO 26262, ASPICE, AUTOSAR — We excel at functional safety, powertrain control, battery management, and ADAS. From OTA updates to secure diagnostics, our solutions combine precision and compliance for tomorrow's vehicles.

items.title: MedTech & Industry 4.0
items.description: With select experience in IEC 62304 and smart manufacturing, our team embeds connectivity (BLE, Wi-Fi, and industrial protocols) to drive secure, data-driven solutions. We help you meet strict compliance without sacrificing innovation.

items.title: Cloud & Application Engineering
items.description: We build multi-platform apps with Kotlin, Flutter, or React — offline-first, secure, and integrated with your backend. Leveraging CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions), we ensure smooth builds, rapid deployment, and scalable cloud architectures.

items.title: Proven Expertise
items.description: 20+ years delivering in complex compliance environments, with a deep record in automotive embedded.

items.title: Continuous Improvement
items.description: Agile methodologies, TDD, code reviews, and tight feedback loops.

items.title: End-to-End Perspective
items.description: From firmware to mobile apps to cloud backends—our holistic approach keeps everything in sync.

items.title: Scalable Collaboration
items.description: Whether a feasibility study or multi-year engagement, we match your roadmap at every step.
